shots.alt: Render of a line-up of three electrical control panels with the right-hand panel open to show breakers, busbars and wiring
Close-up render of copper busbars behind a clear shroud above the main moulded case circuit breaker in an open panel
Close-up render of a panel door with a power meter, red, yellow and blue phase indicator lights, a selector switch and a rotary isolator
Close-up render of contactors, overload relays, miniature circuit breakers and terminal blocks with ferrule-marked wiring in cable ducts
